annotations.title: NicheDB: Find a Product Across Stores

description:
[NicheDB] Find a product and every store selling it, from the product graph: offers that stores state in their own product page data (schema.org Product/Offer), read by the pit.world crawler and joined across stores by barcode or part number. Give `gtin` (any UPC, EAN, ISBN-13 or GTIN-14; hyphens fine) or `brand` + `mpn` for an exact product, or `q` for words (a name, brand, part number or SKU; a bare barcode in `q` works too). `host` keeps one store. Each product has `key`, `name`, `brand`, `gtin`, `mpn`, `stores`, `lowPrice` + `currency` (only when every buyable offer shares one currency) and `offers` sorted buyable-first then cheapest: `seller`, `host`, `price`, `currency`, `availability` (schema.org word: InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder...), `condition`, `variant`, `offerUrl`, `seenAt`. Prices are what the page said when last read, not live; quote `seenAt` with them. No store pays to be listed.

Served by NicheDB (https://nichedb.dev/docs/mcp).

gtin.description: A UPC, EAN, ISBN-13 or GTIN-14 (optional), e.g. 0027242923232

limit.description: Products to return, integer 1-50, default 10, e.g. 5

mpn.description: The maker's part number, with brand (optional), e.g. GSR12V-300B22

q.description: Words to match (optional), e.g. sony wh-1000xm5

name: nichedb_find_product
